## What's changed

- Fixed black video on Apple TV when Tube TV encounters HDR programming by using Apple-compatible HEVC Main 10 fragmented-MP4 HLS instead of H.264 HDR in MPEG-TS.
- Kept Tube TV's codec and profile stable across programs, commercials, and bumpers while applying the correct color-range treatment to each scheduled item.
- Preserved compatible HDR10 and HLG when local-library or Discovery video requires resizing or re-encoding, with HDR10+ safely converted to its HDR10 presentation.
- Added an HDR10 output path for Dolby Vision Profile 7 base layers and retained the existing HDR10/HLG-compatible handling for Dolby Vision Profile 8.
- Kept unsupported Dolby Vision and unavailable HEVC HDR encoders on the safe SDR tone-mapping path.
- Left Steam and retro-player negotiation on their existing playback paths; the new HDR output is selected only for capable Apple TV clients and connected displays.
